morbi.headline: Morbi cluster exhibits mixed signals with gas price relief countered by weak exports and infrastructure concerns.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic industry received a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices dropping from Rs 82.
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed despite an overall weak export outlook.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park for ₹1.21 crore and posted a Q2 2026 sales and profit beat.
stress_signals: Industrialists represented ongoing issues related to electricity supply, water availability, and local infrastructure [8b17a473b62a].
Overall export outlook for the cluster remains weak despite resumed Gulf shipments [c2b4a2f5422a].
A large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53].
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices reduced by Rs 5 following ministerial representations [279312659941].
Kajaria Ceramics reported a Q2 2026 sales and profit beat [83abd2d67eca].
what_to_watch: Monitor utility bill payments and margin impact from the revised natural gas pricing.
Track export order book recovery and shipment volumes heading to Gulf and international markets.
Evaluate local infrastructure bottlenecks regarding power and water supply in industrial estates.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe payment delays and power cost shocks amid pre-Diwali demand revival.
what_changed: Textile PLI scheme turnover threshold was halved and extended to FY 2033-34.
Embroidery workers in Surat ended their labor movement following an agreement with unit owners.
ICA GemLab was launched in Surat for international-grade diamond testing.
stress_signals: Surat weavers protested as textile payment dues exceeded 200 days ahead of Diwali [774ba602b06e].
Payment dispute between Surat traders and weavers reached the police station [80f44f3f370f].
Surat textile mills faced power cuts and electricity cost hikes [385f9b90ae46].
A fire damaged a Pandesara textile unit causing losses worth one crore rupees [dba1533f8fd5].
improvement_signals: Surat's diamond industry saw revival amid global demand ahead of Diwali [01cb30b63e0d].
Surat textile market traders recovered Rs 6 crore in stuck payments [a523a4bf860d].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital cycles and overdue receivables of weavers and traders ahead of the festive season.
Track potential labor unrest following prior agitation warnings in textile units [d1fffb80f879].
Observe the implementation and impact of the revised PLI scheme thresholds on local manufacturing units.
